identity.purpose: Read-only typed drum metadata closure; not firmware, design implementation or acceptance
identity.record_scope: 22 playable voices plus one KIT record for each kit (24 records)
identity.forbidden_inputs: No private #684 header was fetched or included.

dispatch_contract.synth_target: T_303 is a different domain; its local ID tables must not format, edit or draw drum local IDs
dispatch_contract.unmapped_slots: R_NONE stays unmapped; a synth-only guard must not reject a valid mapped drum reference
dispatch_contract.canonical_base_owner: proj.sound.v[target][voice][local_parameter_id]; page, label, physical knob and view are projections, not independent storage owners
dispatch_contract.shared_sound_mix: Sound/MORE and MIX use the same canonical reference where the parameter is exposed. The selected voice and visible kit resolve before the reference is built.

readout_rules.raw_integer: Return the bounded raw integer and no unit. Do not append percent just because maximum_raw is 127.
readout_rules.enum_name: Use enum_names[raw] when in range; otherwise INVALID. Raw0 is the first listed name, not an assumed OFF.
readout_rules.pan_L64_C_R63: 64 => C; raw<64 => L+(64-raw); raw>64 => R+(raw-64). No unit.
readout_rules.engineering_value_times_100_rounded: Starting from the DSP engineering value v, the SI mapper sets x=v*100 and returns PCT; the UI then prints int(x+0.5) and %. Do not multiply the SI result by100 again.
readout_rules.raw_over_127_times_100_rounded: For 808 BD/SD X controls, source SI uses raw*100/127; it need not equal the native engineering range.
readout_rules.gain_to_dB_or_OFF: x<=0 => OFF/no unit; otherwise 6.0206f*fm_log2f(x), source put_d1 with signed one decimal below absolute10, otherwise whole dB.
readout_rules.hertz_auto_Hz_or_kHz: SI x<999.5 => nearest integer Hz; otherwise source put_d1(x/1000) kHz.
readout_rules.milliseconds_auto_ms_or_s: SI x<999.5 => nearest integer ms; otherwise source put_d1(x/1000) s.
readout_rules.seconds_auto_ms_or_s: SI x<0.9995 => nearest integer x*1000 ms; otherwise source put_d1(x) s.
readout_rules.ratio_to_signed_semitones: 12*fm_log2f(engine_ratio), then source put_d1 with sign and st.

public_exp_tables_909.generated_header: build/gen/x0x_drum_tables.h (generated, absent from the inspected tracked tree)
public_exp_tables_909.actual_accessor: x0x_pot_exp_value reconstructs packed exact binary32 bits; metadata does not claim a runtime table was executed or a candidate build used a particular generated header

public_808_conversion.formula: pot_value: if exp and min>0, min*d8_pow(max/min,raw/127); otherwise min+(max-min)*raw/127. Exception: set_pot passes D8P_DIST through as float(raw), not this normalized formula.
public_808_conversion.native_math: d8_pow/d8_exp2_cr and public fastmath fm_log2f; no private synth table is needed
public_808_conversion.si_base_mapping: drum808_param_si uses its fixed base-sound array. The setter/getter use the active Sound switch for K_POT and fixed MA for K_FIXED. Preserve this source distinction.

scope_contract.base: Normal valid knob turns clamp and write the canonical project sound cell. A sound-view parameter and its mixer alias do not get separate page-keyed values.
scope_contract.motion: While playing, a normal sound turn records/allocates its current pattern+part+target+voice+parameter lane when REC is on, or holds an existing lane for a pass when REC is off.
scope_contract.display_priority: matrix_value starts with base; a held-step lock overrides it when present; otherwise an active motion value can override it. Absent lock inherits base. Do not claim every display is the stored base.
scope_contract.step_lock: Only V_PART without overlay exposes lock_step. For drums the held kit, selected voice and pattern must still match. A valid engine parameter must belong to the same kit part. SEQ→PART preserves that hold; MIX→PART does not.
scope_contract.held_mix: MIX is not steps_view and lock_step is false there: K2 stays page/list navigation; K5–K8 keep ordinary mix parameters. Holding a pad does not create a new p-lock scope.
scope_contract.lock_clear: BT + knob while held clears only that step lock; normal BT + sound knob forgets the whole current-pattern motion lane. Stopped release restores base preview.
scope_contract.identity: Motion/lock keys include pattern and step where applicable, but their parameter owner is still target+voice+localID. Never use Chicago bank ID, sound-page index or knob number as that identity.

step_press_release_contract.on_empty_press: Create the hit immediately and record hold_created=true. A short release must not remove the hit created by that same press.
step_press_release_contract.on_existing_press: Do not delete. Record hold_step, hold_drum=kit*NDRUM+selected_voice, hold_pat, hold_t0, hold_used=0 and hold_created=false.
step_press_release_contract.on_release: Delete an existing hit only when same absolute step, kit/voice and pattern still match, hold_created is false, hold_used is false and elapsed<300ms. A same-owner 800ms hold/release preserves the hit. After resolving a matching white release, clear hold_step.
step_press_release_contract.cancel: drum_step_cancel clears hold_step; if an edited stopped preview belongs to the current owner it restores before clearing. Later release is not interpreted as a short tap. Track changes, part changes and ordinary view changes call cancellation; only SEQ→PART is the intentional preservation exception. Do not assume every page change shares that exception.
step_press_release_contract.mix_specific: Ordinary MIX knob turns do not mark hold_used through the step-lock path. Preserve actual press/release timing instead of either immediately toggling an existing hit or disabling the mapped MIX pad route.
step_press_release_contract.out_of_length: Input accepts indices0–63 even beyond loop length; LED content remains bounded by length and loop length is not extended.

song_light_contract.used_pattern: Both HOME and SONG add dim WHITE_KEY bits for every pattern_used in the visible bank.
song_light_contract.selected_pattern: HOME adds bright current PART_909 pattern. SONG adds bright selected-bar PART_909 pattern only when ui.song_sel < song.len; an empty Song or END row has no current-pattern bright fallback.
song_light_contract.queue: Only HOME adds its cue blink; SONG does not inherit it.
song_light_contract.empty_song_used_P1_fixture: With selected909, normal dark-theme hue, LIGHTS on, no held input and P1 used: physical pad0 is dim RGB[31,18,5] =0x1f1205, not Home-current bright. This is source arithmetic, not a new physical observation.
song_light_contract.held_override: Held white input is a later bright layer; exclude it when qualifying the unheld empty-Song fixture.
